Create Phantasm: Numen
Any•Arcane•Spell•50 MP
[object Object]
Engagement
TargetTest Target Enemy
AttackerKeren
Effect

You can now have up to 4 active Phantasms, but one of them must necessarily be Numen. Also, you cannot have more than one Numen Phantasm active at a time. This Phantasm cannot be used in any of the Illusionist’s Skills or Spells.

Numen is bound by the same set of special rules as any other Phantasm, with the following exceptions:

  • Numen Phantasms cost 50 MP to cast.
  • Numen’s Phantasmal Vitality equals twice your base Insight die size plus your level.
  • Once active, Numen acts at the end of your turn: it performs a free action — one Attack or Skill of its own — chosen and driven automatically. It holds no turn of its own, and does not benefit from Spells that grant additional actions.

When creating a Numen Phantasm you are prompted to choose one essence, which dictates Numen’s damage type for as long as it remains on the field:

  • Ravana — Physical
  • Asura — Light
  • Diablos — Dark

The target hit by Numen suffers 【HR + 14】 damage.

Damage dealt by Numen ignores Resistances and Immunities.

The range of the attack is determined by your current weapon.

Numen’s Phantasmal Vitality, MP and damage are all derived from you at the moment of summoning — its own sheet holds only the unscaled baseline.

Skill Enhancement Lv. 20 ― Numen’s on-hit damage increases to 18.

Skill Enhancement Lv. 40 ― Numen’s on-hit damage increases to 20.

Confirm
